The graph above shows the relationship between the speed of a particular truck, in miles per hour, and its corresponding braking distance, in feet. Approximately how many feet greater will the truck's braking distance be when the truck is traveling at $50$ miles per hour than when the truck is traveling at $20$ miles per hour?
explanation: Choice C is correct. According to the graph, when the truck is traveling at $50$ miles per hour, the braking distance is approximately $160$ feet, and when the truck is traveling at $20$ miles per hour, the braking distance is approximately $30$ feet. The difference between these braking distances is $160 - 30$, or $130$ feet.
